title: Johnson County Library (JCL) Central Fleet EV Chargers Installation Project

onscreen_lines.desc: BASE BID #1 (LUMP SUM): Install three (3) electrical vehicle chargers at the Johnson County Central Resource Library, include the provision of all other materials, labor, equipment, supervision, and any and all other items necessary to complete the project in accordance with the Clark & Enersen Drawings titled "Johnson County CRL Fleet EV Charging Stations" dated August 12, 2026, and the Project Manual dated October 27, 2026. Note: EV Chargers will be provided by the Owner.
onscreen_lines.block: 1 BASE BID #1 (LUMP SUM): Install three (3) electrical vehicle chargers at the Johnson County Central Resource Library, include the provision of all other materials, labor, equipment, supervision, and any and all other items necessary to complete the project in accordance with the Clark & Enersen Drawings titled "Johnson County CRL Fleet EV Charging Stations" dated August 12, 2026, and the Project Manual dated October 27, 2026. Note: EV Chargers will be provided by the Owner. 1 LS No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: ALTERNATE #1 (LUMP SUM): Provide all labor, materials, equipment, and services necessary to install a wall-mounted EPO Pushbutton per Key Note 8 on page E1.01 of the Clark & Enersen Drawings dated August 12, 2026.
